issues.on_page: p8 column header Water: 101,890 / 45,593; p2 Statement of Activities and p10 budget schedule show 101,890 / 45,593 as Sewer and 52,810 / 20,492 as Water
issues.issue: The report contradicts itself on which column is Water and which is Sewer. The extractor followed the p8 headers and added a review note, but did not add a decision_needed entry. A person should settle which fund is which.

The grant's source (state, federal or private) is not stated, and p2 lists it under general revenues rather than operating grants. The category is defensible but is an assumption (the line has a review note). The same applies to detail[40].
This Pool Fund charge could go under the user's Recreation Fees receipt category. The generic printed label makes charges for services defensible.
